name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 77 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 39 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.2 days starting 2026-02-23, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.95 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
